Method of Attack: Encrypts victim's files using Blowfish encryption algorithm
Creates HTA ransom note 'How to restore files.hta' in encrypted folders
Creates autorun entry to open ransom note on Windows login
Deletes Shadow Volume Copies using vssadmin.exe
Disables Windows Startup Repair using bcdedit.exe
Changes Windows wallpaper to Purge movie themed image
Checks for sandbox or virtual machine environments and terminates if detected
Attack Vector: Unknown distribution method; checks and avoids sandbox or virtual machine environments such as Anubis, VirtualBox, VMware, Virtual PC
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom note file: How to restore files.hta
Ransomware files: msiscan.exe, How to decrypt your files.jpg
Registry entries: HKCU\Software\Globe, HKCU\Control Panel\Desktop\Wallpaper set to %UserProfile%\How to decrypt your files.jpg
Autorun registry: HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run 'How to restore files' = 'mshta.exe "%UserProfile%\How to restore files.hta"'
